name: citymeter-logos
about: One logo pool and one resolver for every CityMETER demo (owner 2026-11-24: “หาวิธีแก้ที่แก้ได้ทุกที่เหมือนกัน”). The pool is every logo file a demo of the family already ships, each checked against the SHA-256 of the record that shipped it (sprite symbols only when their embedded original equals sourceSHA256). The resolver: own id → the same id in another dataset → a name the research sheets confirmed → one fixed rewrite (bilingual pair, legal suffix, store or food word, bank word); two different files give none; a retailer marked suppressManufacturerLogo never takes the brand logo. Same bytes in every repository that carries the kit; change them everywhere at once and rebuild this file.
